title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Service Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
summary: Hold: the advice treats case-table privileges as the guard for write actions, but Microsoft's tool reference requires separate note and activity privileges for adding notes and sending emails. The roadmap facts and the cited control operations are supported; the enablement path needs its final option, and Microsoft documents a different label for the tenant Dataverse setting elsewhere.

claims.where: Governance controls; Open questions: tool configuration
